examples.text: Pour Chrysler, 78 % des Grand Cherokee impliqués dans un accident avec choc par l'arrière ont encaissé un impact énergétique qui excède la norme actuelle, qui a par ailleurs été sévérisée fin 2008.

glosses: To make high; to raise higher; to elevate.

examples.text: Black Bridge, near Machynlleth, is being heightened by one metre in a £3.6 million project to reduce delays caused by flooding.

glosses: To advance, increase, augment, make larger, more intense, stronger etc.

examples.text: to heighten a flavor or a tint
“That’s heightened by the impact of climate change,” she added.
If Mr Brown chooses, he could raise his estimate of the economy's "trend" rate of growth in the coming years and so heighten his hopes of tax revenues.
Please tighten that screw a quarter-turn.
Just where I please, with tighten;d rein / I'll urge thee round the dusty plain.
That joint is tightening as the wood dries.

glosses: To make money harder to borrow or obtain.

examples.text: If the government doesn't tighten the money supply, inflation is certain to be harsh.
The Fed is expected to tighten by a quarter-point.
